name: Groß-Gerau (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Groß-Gerau (a Hessian lion on blue above a cross on yellow and red, under a mural crown).
history: The flag was approved for the city together with the arms on 22 January 1996.

features.role: Groß-Gerau arms — Hessian lion with mural crown
